title: Optimizing Expert-Designed Crystal Graph Networks for Band-Gap Prediction with an Autonomous LLM Research Loop
abstract: arXiv:2606.29717v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Predicting a material's properties from its structure is a central, fast-advancing problem in computational materials science. A decade of work has produced standard public benchmarks and many published machine-learning models for the task (Dunn et al., 2020). The task's fixed metric and these baselines make it a natural setting for autonomous agent research (Karpathy, 2026). On the MatBench band-gap benchmark ($>$100k crystals), a general-purpose coding agent autonomously built the most accurate model trained without external pretraining, ahead of all seventeen expert-designed models reported for the task. A closer analysis shows it reached this by implementing known methods: either already standard in crystal neural-network models, or borrowed from other areas of machine learning. translated_title: 优化专家设计的晶体图网络用于带隙预测：一个自主LLM研究循环
translated_abstract: 摘要：从材料结构预测其性质是计算材料科学中一个核心且快速发展的课题。过去十年的工作已经产生了标准的公共基准和许多已发表的机器学习模型（Dunn等人，2020）。该任务的固定指标和这些基线使其成为自主智能体研究的自然场景（Karpathy，2026）。在MatBench带隙基准（包含超过10万个晶体）上，一个通用编程智能体自主构建了最准确的模型，该模型在没有外部预训练的情况下训练，超越了该任务中报告的所有十七个专家设计的模型。进一步分析表明，它通过实现已知方法达到了这一目标：这些方法要么在晶体神经网络模型中已是标准，要么借鉴了机器学习的其他领域。其贡献的实现包括在每个消息传递边上使用元素对特征，以及晶体空间群嵌入。这项工作不仅...
tldr: 本文展示了一个自主LLM研究循环能够优化专家设计的晶体图网络，在带隙预测基准上超越所有专家模型，其关键在于实现了元素对特征和空间群嵌入等已知技术。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates an autonomous LLM research loop that optimizes expert-designed crystal graph networks, surpassing all expert models on band-gap prediction benchmarks by implementing known techniques like element-pair features and space-group embeddings.
